messages:
Maria Chen: hey team — spotted a billing/credits mismatch on the embeds console for mixed-dim payloads. example: client sends 2x 768-dim vectors in a 1024-dim route and console shows 4 units consumed instead of 2. anyone seen this behavior? cc @Alex Kim @Devon Singh
Alex Kim: ugh that sounds like the old slot-padding double-count bug. do we still compute units as `ceil(padded_dim / slot_size)` per vector and then re-pad?
Devon Singh: quick check — the runtime currently pads each tensor to the route's slot (1024) before unit calc, so 768 becomes 1024 -> counted as 1 unit per vector but quota conversion multiplies again somewhere. need logs.
Maria Chen: attaching a minimal repro I grabbed from telemetry: ``REQUEST id=abc123 route=embeds-1024 dims=[768,768] unit_calc_step=pad->count -> units_reported=4``
Sara Patel: iirc billing model was: units = sum(ceil(dim / 256)) where 256 is our billing quantum, independent of route slot. seems like route slot padding crept into the pipeline.
Alex Kim: right — two competing measurements: runtime-internal `route_slots` and billing `quantum_units`. a recent change to routing to optimize memory started writing the padded shape into the request metadata and our quota service reads that metadata.
infra-bot: Canary deploy finished: embeds-route-optimizer v2 -> 3/3 hosts. No errors reported.
Devon Singh: propose fix: stop propagating padded_shape into quota payload; instead send raw dims and let quota service compute `ceil(dim/QUANTUM)`. simple patch and add unit tests.
PM_Jon: if we change meter semantics will customers see different invoices? need migration notes and console flag to toggle, plus a message in billing dashboard.
Sara Patel: agree. plan: (1) patch runtime to send raw dims (2) add metric `billing.embed_units_v2` and `billing.embed_units_v1` for 2 weeks overlap (3) console toggle + banner explaining opt-in to new billing calcs (4) rollout via feature-flag canary.
Alex Kim: metric names sound good. telemetry: we should emit per-request fields: `requested_dims`, `route_slot`, `units_v1`, `units_v2` and a `reconciliation_delta`. add logs at sampling rate 1% to avoid high cardinality.
Maria Chen: sample log snippet I want in the dashboard: ```{request_id:abc123, dims:[768,768], route_slot:1024, units_old:4, units_new:2, delta:-2}```. Can we surface a reconciliation gauge per-tenant?
Devon Singh: yes — we'll add a per-tenant `embed_unit_discrepancy` gauge and an alert if > 5% of requests differ for 24h.
PM_Jon: timeline? customers on Dedicated might need heads up and a billing contact. Also add FAQ for the console explaining why counted units may drop.
Sara Patel: ETA: patch + tests by EOD Wednesday, metrics + dashboard tiles by Friday, canary next week behind flag `embed_dim_billing_v2`. I'll draft console copy.
Alex Kim: small gotcha — some partners rely on `route_slot` for performance expectations. we must not change routing behavior, only metadata emitted to quota. confirm with eng-runtime.
Maria Chen: noted. @Devon can you add a quick unit test that simulates mixed dims and asserts units_v1 != units_v2 when padding present? also post the canary checklist.
Devon Singh: will do. checklist draft: ``- feature flag off by default; - metric backfill for 7d; - migration banner; - QA load test with 50k mixed-dim vectors``
infra-bot: Note: scheduled job `billing-metrics-backfill` will run tonight at 02:00 UTC.
Sara Patel: assigning tasks: Devon (patch + tests), Alex (telemetry + dashboards), Maria (QA run + repro), PM_Jon (billing comms). I'll create the flag and console banner PR.
Maria Chen: thanks. if anyone wants to eyeball the repro it lives in `/infra/repro/embed_padding_bug/README.md` — quick smoke: ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H 'X-Embed-Dim:768' -d '[..]'``
PM_Jon: once metrics are live we'll run a dry-run billing report for a week and share with finance and a few beta customers. :+1:
Alex Kim: one more note — add a lightweight console widget: show `units_v1 vs units_v2` for recent requests (sampled). helps SEs debug cost regressions.
Sara Patel: good idea. adding to dashboard PR.
Maria Chen: resolved for now — thanks all. follow-ups in the PRs.
